channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Bengaluru Double Tragedy: New Bride Ganavi Dies Within a Month of Marriage, Husband Suraj Ends Life Amid Dowry Probe
item.description: A Bengaluru couple's marriage ends in tragedy within weeks, with dowry allegations fuelling a police probe into back-to-back suicides.

item.title: Could Omega-3 Help Reduce the Risk of Heart Disease? Here’s What Research Suggests
item.description: Recent research suggests Omega-3 fatty acids may lower heart disease risk in India by tackling triglycerides and inflammation, but only alongside balanced diets and exercise.

item.title: Mumbai Bus Accident: Four Dead, Several Injured After BEST Bus Mows Down Pedestrians in Bhandup
item.description: Four people died and 14 others sustained injuries after a BEST bus mowed down pedestrians in Mumbai's Bhandup.

item.title: Delhi High Court: Father Cannot Dodge Child Maintenance Because Mother Earns More; Shared Parental Duty Is Non-Negotiable
item.description: Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma upholds ₹50,000 monthly support, stressing both parents' shared legal and moral obligations beyond income parity.

item.title: Uttarakhand Police Say Angel Chakma Death Not Racial, Clash Over Remarks In Jest, 5 Arrested; All You Need to Know
item.description: A 24-year-old student, Angel Chakma, from Tripura died in Dehradun after allegedly being attacked for resisting racial slurs.

item.title: Dense Fog Puts Delhi on Red Alert, Cancels Over 128 Flights as Visibility Drops to 50 Metres and Air Turns Severe
item.description: Dense fog has plunged Delhi into a red alert crisis, cancelling 128 flights and delaying trains amid severe pollution and near-zero visibility.

item.title: Operation Aaghat 3.0: Delhi Police Conduct All-Out Sweep, Arrest Over 600, Seize Arms, Drugs Ahead of New Year
item.description: Operation Aaghat 3.0: Delhi Police arrested over 600 individuals in a massive district-wide security sweep before New Year celebrations.

item.title: Mumbai’s 68-Year-Old Loses Rs 3.71 Crore to Cyber Scammers Posing as Justice Chandrachud in Fake Digital Arrest
item.description: Retired Mumbai woman loses Rs 3.71 crore to fake "Justice Chandrachud" digital arrest scam; Surat man arrested.

item.title: Thalapathy Vijay Trips and Falls Amid Wild Fan Mob at Chennai Airport After Jana Nayagan Malaysia Audio Launch Event
item.description: Thalapathy Vijay fell near car at Chennai Airport due to fan mob but escaped unharmed via quick security.

item.title: Stampede Panic at Rapper Vedan’s Bekal Beach Festival in Kerala’s Kasaragod Leaves Over 15 Injured, Including Children
item.description: A stampede-like panic at Malayalam rapper Vedan’s Bekal Beach Festival gig injured 15, including children, and led to a 19-year-old's death after youths fled across railway tracks into an oncoming train.
